name: Knowledge source (org/enterprise)
description: Persistent context blob Devin uses across sessions. Fields: name, trigger, body. Three tiers: org, enterprise, repo. Per-repo: Devin only sees knowledge entries for the repo it's working on.

name: Knowledge onboarding (uploading knowledge to Devin)
description: Initial process to populate Devin's knowledge base for a repo or org. Documented at /onboard-devin/knowledge-onboarding.

name: Playbook (creating)
description: Reusable instruction set encoded once and triggered by name/macro across surfaces (Slack/Teams/Jira/Linear). Fields: name, instructions, optional macro (e.g., `!plan`).

name: Playbook (using)
description: Trigger paths: assign ticket to Devin (default playbook), label macro (`!plan`/`!implement`/`!triage`/`!review`), Slack/Teams keyword `![macro]`, or `assign + comment` flows.

name: Playbook macro identifier
description: Optional `!`-prefixed identifier on a playbook. Required for label-based triggers in Jira/Linear and Slack-keyword triggers like `![ship-it]`.

name: Default playbook (per integration)
description: Per-integration setting for which playbook fires when triggered without a specific macro. Linear default for new connections: `!plan`. Configurable in Jira/Linear settings.

name: Knowledge `trigger` field
description: Knowledge note field describing WHEN the knowledge applies. Devin surfaces matching knowledge into context based on trigger relevance.

name: Knowledge folder (structure)
description: Hierarchical folder structure for knowledge notes. Both org and enterprise scope. Folder structure with note counts retrievable via API.

name: Knowledge suggestion (pending)
description: AI-generated suggestion for new knowledge entries based on observed session patterns. List/view/dismiss via the devin_knowledge_manage MCP tool.

name: Secret
description: Stored credential referenced as $VARIABLE_NAME from blueprints, sessions, and playbooks. Three tiers (enterprise, org, repo) with cascading precedence (more specific wins on name collision).

name: Secret rotation
description: Rotate by deleting old + creating new (or by upserting in UI). New value takes effect on the next build for blueprint-referenced secrets. Recommended best practice: regular rotation cadence.

name: Secret cascade precedence
description: Secrets cascade enterprise → org → repo with more specific tiers winning on name collision. Use intentionally to override enterprise defaults at the team level.

name: Secret naming convention
description: Best-practice: use descriptive names like `INTERNAL_NPM_TOKEN`, not `TOKEN_1`. Avoids confusion across multiple admins and over time.

name: Never put secrets in YAML rule
description: Strong best-practice: NEVER put secrets directly in blueprint YAML. Secrets in YAML end up in logs, build artifacts, and audit trails. Use the secrets management UI instead.

name: Secret audit (periodic review)
description: Best-practice: periodically review which secrets exist and whether they're still needed. Remove unused secrets to reduce attack surface.

name: Knowledge additivity across blueprint tiers
description: Knowledge items are additive across enterprise/org/repo tiers. Devin sees all of them. Multiple tiers can define same-named knowledge items without overwriting.

name: Playbook `instructions` field
description: Body of a playbook. Free-form text describing what Devin should do when the playbook fires.

name: Programmatic playbook management (devin_playbook_manage)
description: MCP tool exposed by Devin MCP for full CRUD on playbooks (list/get/create/update/delete) including macro support. Org-level + enterprise-level.

name: Programmatic knowledge management (devin_knowledge_manage)
description: MCP tool exposed by Devin MCP for full CRUD on knowledge notes + suggestions (list/get/create/update/delete; browse folder structure; manage suggestions). Filterable by repo/folder/search.
